title: Lumora Plugin Manifest
description: Schema for lumora.plugin.json — the manifest file for a Lumora plugin.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference (optional, for editor autocomplete).

id.description: Unique reverse-DNS plugin identifier. Must match the plugin folder name. Stable for the life of the install.

name.description: Human-readable name shown in Settings → Extensions.

version.description: Semver version string for the plugin.

apiVersion.description: Host API contract version. Currently must be 1.

description.description: Short description shown in the Extensions list (optional).

permissions.description: Permission tokens the plugin requires. May be empty for no-op/read-only plugins.

contributions.description: Extension points contributed by this plugin.

actions.description: Selection-scoped commands that appear in the Plugins submenu.

events.description: Reserved for future use. Ignored in v1.

panels.description: Reserved for future use. Ignored in v1.

providers.description: Reserved for future use. Ignored in v1.

views.description: Reserved for future use. Ignored in v1.

main.description: Relative path to the JavaScript entry module. Required when contributions.actions is non-empty.

id.description: Unique action identifier within this plugin.

label.description: Menu label shown to the user.

scope.description: Scope of the action. Only 'selection' is supported in v1.

minSelection.description: Minimum number of selected assets required to enable the action.

maxSelection.description: Maximum number of selected assets the action accepts. Hard limit is 500.
